description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-based specialty coffee chain with a location inside Library Square, a busy commercial and office complex in the heart of downtown Vancouver. The cafe serves a full espresso menu alongside specialty drinks such as nitro coffee, whole-leaf teas, and the signature Blue Matcha Latte, plus a range of baked goods, breakfast sandwiches, and wraps. It sits on Robson Street, a key cycling corridor connecting the West End to downtown, making it a convenient stop for urban touring cyclists.
